outcome: sonographically determined descent of the rectal ampulla
Gh + Pb (a measure of pelvic organ support)
cohort: The study included 1,443 postmenopausal women with pelvic floor dysfunction attending a tertiary urogynecology center.
finding: Current hormone therapy use was significantly associated with a minor negative effect on pelvic organ support, specifically increased descent of the rectal ampulla and changes in Gh + Pb, although the clinical relevance was deemed small.
mod_finding: History of forceps delivery was controlled for as a confounding factor in the multivariate analysis.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from January 2012 to March 2015
